features: Add a dedicated Pionex Live Monitor page opened from the main navigation in a new tab.
Move the existing Champion performance page into the More menu without changing its calculations.
Support dynamic SPOT/PERP watchlist additions, sortable columns, editable notes and R2 cross-device autosave.
Use Pionex public WebSocket trades for live prices and patch only changed table cells every 10 seconds without page reload flicker.
Warm each newly added symbol from Pionex daily klines through the Worker/R2 cache and recalculate live S-State, midline regime, Heikin-Ashi average-K color and CCI-SMA color.
Add Worker routes for monitor watchlist, current Pionex tradable universe and cached kline warm-up.
Fix Pionex monitor symbol-list 403/429 by removing live full-universe fetches from the Cloudflare user request path.
Sync the complete current Pionex SPOT/PERP universe into R2 from a dedicated GitHub Actions job every 6 hours and on demand.
Keep the add-symbol dialog usable with a fallback list and direct typed symbol candidates even before the first R2 universe sync.
